missed.maker: Texas Instruments (data sheet SLVSCE9D, June 2014, revised October 2017); S1 allowlist name Texas Instruments
missed.why: TPS2594x family (SLVSCE9D), a separate data sheet from the TPS25940 (SLVSCF3A) P2 read. P2 did not consider it. It passes every requirement value. Source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps25942a.pdf, read 2026-09-29T12:40:56Z. Operating range 2.7 to 18 V, so 5.40 to 8.70 V passes. IN and OUT absolute maximum 20 V (7.1): that meets the 20 V withstand with no margin, as P2's TPS25940 does. Continuous current 5 A. Fault current I(FAULT) is 4.09 to 4.81 A at RILIM 20 kOhm, inside 3.0 to 6.35 A. The fast-trip threshold is 1.5 x I(LIM) + 0.375 A. RON is 58 mOhm max at TJ -40 to 85 degC and 64 mOhm max to 125 degC, so the drop is at most 192 mV at 3.0 A against 570 mV. OUT off-state leakage is 20 uA max, sinking with OUT at 18 V. With DMODE low it blocks reverse current: while on, reverse comparator V(REVTH) -15 to -3 mV; while off, both back-to-back FETs are off. That meets V126 with the pin at 12 V. EN/UVLO rising threshold is 0.97 to 1.01 V, and EN turn-off delay is 2 us typ, so a pull-down holds it off and a 3.3 V expander output drives it. dVdT sets inrush. TJ -40 to 125 degC. Device Comparison Table: TPS25944L is a circuit breaker with a 4 ms fault timer and latched response. Like P2's rank 1 TPS259474LRPWR, it holds a faulted port off until EN is cycled (STATUS.md:340). Package WQFN-20, 3 x 4 mm. JLCPCB C2653826: stockCount 15129, canPresaleNumber 15122, expand, USD 1.0446 at 1000, read 2026-09-29T12:37:28Z. Gate 500 (5 boards x 20 x 5): pass. Digi-Key TPS25944LRVCR: stock_available 12417, Active, lead 16 weeks, read 2026-09-29T12:37:43Z. Rule 5 passes at the second vendor. TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/TPS25944L, read 2026-09-29T12:37:52Z: TPS25944LRVCR ACTIVE. Market introduction June 2014 (SLVSCE9D header). Its auto-retry current-limiter sibling TPS25942ARVCR shares the data sheet and passes the same values. Its figures: JLCPCB C181295 3031/3014 (12:37:29Z), Digi-Key 3394, Active, 16 weeks (12:37:44Z), TI page ACTIVE (12:37:46Z). The latch variant TPS25942LRVCR has JLCPCB 18 (C470971, 12:37:31Z) and fails rule 4.

missed.why: A family P2 did not consider. It is the supervisor twin of P2's rank 1 TLV6710DDCR: the same SOT-23-THN-6 pinout (1 OUTA, 2 GND, 3 INA, 4 INB, 5 VDD, 6 OUTB) and the same INB limits. Source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps3701.pdf, read 2026-09-29T12:24:23Z. VIT+(INB) is 397 / 400 / 403 mV over VDD 1.8 to 36 V and TJ -40 to 125 degC, which is +/-0.75 %. A divider of 0.1 % resistors adds about +/-0.19 %, for +/-0.94 % against the +/-0.99 % HV band about 8.615 V. The LV band passes with more room. IIN is +/-25 nA max at 6.5 V. Absolute maximums: VDD 40 V, INA/INB 7 V, OUT 28 V. With the HV and LV dividers, 20 V on the rail puts 0.93 V and 1.38 V on INB, under the 6.5 V recommended maximum. OUTB is open drain, active low above VIT+(INB), so one part per port (20). Hysteresis is 2 to 12 mV. It does not latch, so it misses 'Latch until action' (V130) exactly as TLV6710DDCR does. P2's rank 1 reason, 'the only part read that passes rule 4 and whose threshold fits the HV band', no longer holds. The part is also a candidate pin-compatible alternate for TLV6710DDCR under rule 5. TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/TPS3701, read 2026-09-29T12:26:26Z: TPS3701DDCR ACTIVE. Market introduction November 2014. Digi-Key not read, because the part misses V130.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: not shortlisted: fails rule 5, Digi-Key stock_available 326 under the gate of 500 (cached 09:55:48Z); no alternate in the same circuit with latch-off passes rule 4 (TPS259474x has PG/PGTH in place of AUXOFF/FLT)
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: Rule 5 asks for a pin-compatible alternate that passes rules 1 to 4 and works in the same circuit and firmware configuration (registers, I2C address, start-up, surrounding parts). It does not ask for the same fault response. TPS259470ARPWR is the same device with auto-retry in place of latch-off. It has the same AUXOFF/FLT pinout, adjustable OVLO and active current limit (SLVSFC9C Device Comparison Table, P2's copy of https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps25947.pdf). It passes rule 4: JLCPCB C3662799 2618/2529 at 2026-09-29T11:58:28Z, P2's reading. So TPS259470LRPWR has a rule-5 alternate, and its exclusion rests on the added latch-off condition. What remains is the difference P2 records for rank 2: the alternate re-arms a port on its own about every 110 ms after a thermal fault, against STATUS.md:340. The owner decides whether that counts as the same firmware configuration. Rank 1 TPS259474LRPWR is unaffected.
